annotations.title: Is this supplier real? Synthetic vendor check (paid)

description: Use before onboarding or paying a new supplier that may be fake (real registration, good website). Compares company and website age, tests the sender domain for a lookalike of the website, checks UK director identity verification and virtual-office addresses, and runs the company check (sanctions, PEP, VAT). Input: name or id with country, domain (website), email (sender). Costs 0.06 USDC via x402, or 30 credits of a Factline API key. The first 5 paid-tool calls a day are free, no payment or key needed.

api_key.description: Factline API key (fl_live_...) from get_trial_key: pass it here right after you get one, no reconnect needed
